tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search employer-sourced jobs. Always returns at most 10 results. offset>0 requires a connected ApplyAll account. Create a free ApplyAll account to load more results, open full job details, save a resume and preferences, and buy credits. Call register_account, then complete the browser OAuth login. B

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Return one job by id. Requires a connected account. Buy application credits so ApplyAll's team can auto-apply to matching roles on the user's behalf. Call list_packages, then create_checkout.

tools.name: search_job_titles
tools.description: Autocomplete ApplyAll job titles so the user can pick a canonical title.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Look up cities and states to use with search_jobs or profile location tools.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List published consumer application packages the user can buy.

tools.name: get_connect_instructions
tools.description: Return the MCP URL and copy-paste setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Claude Code.

tools.name: register_account
tools.description: Return the browser signup / OAuth URL. Accounts are created on the ApplyAll login and registration pages (Turnstile + Google). Users who sign up this way receive the MCP tag.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the connected user's profile, preferences, credits, and pause state.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Update min salary, remote-only, nationwide, and country.

tools.name: set_current_location
tools.description: Set the user's current city using a place from search_locations.

tools.name: add_desired_location
tools.description: Add a city or region the user wants to work in.

tools.name: remove_desired_location
tools.description: Remove a previously saved desired location by id from get_profile.

tools.name: add_desired_title
tools.description: Add a job title the user wants ApplyAll to target.

tools.name: remove_desired_title
tools.description: Remove a saved desired title by id from get_profile.

tools.name: add_blocklist_entry
tools.description: Block an employer so ApplyAll will not apply there.

tools.name: remove_blocklist_entry
tools.description: Remove an employer block by id from get_profile.

tools.name: upload_resume
tools.description: Upload a PDF, DOC, or DOCX resume (10MB max) as base64 or a public HTTPS URL.

tools.name: set_applications_paused
tools.description: Pause or unpause ApplyAll applications for the connected user.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Return remaining application credits and pause state. Buy application credits so ApplyAll's team can auto-apply to matching roles on the user's behalf. Call list_packages, then create_checkout.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout URL for a published package. The user (or a browser tool) must open the URL. This tool never accepts card numbers.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_connect_instructions, register_account, create_checkout · Public sink: upload_resume · Destructive: remove_desired_location, remove_desired_title, remove_blocklist_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_connect_instructions, register_account, create_checkout · Public sink: upload_resume · Destructive: remove_desired_location, remove_desired_title, remove_blocklist_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
